season_title: Season 2: Meeting the Parents (സച്ചിൻ & റീനു: കുടുംബസമേതം)

season_arc.synopsis: On a relaxed Kochi evening, Sachin and Reenu are playfully bickering over burnt Maggi noodles when sudden, authoritative knocks echo through Reenu's apartment door. Panicking at the sound of familiar voices outside, Reenu shoves Sachin behind the kitchen curtain just as she swings open the door to reveal her stern parents standing with hefty travel suitcases.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Father Roy steps into the living room and immediately spots Sachin's stray yellow sneaker peeking out from beneath the kitchen curtain.

season_arc.synopsis: Forced out of hiding, a flustered Sachin tries to pass himself off as the helpful building neighbor who came by solely to fix the balcony latch. Father Roy sits cross-legged on the sofa and unleashes a forensic barrage of questions regarding Sachin's lineage, steady employment, and odd presence in Kochi. Just as Reenu attempts to rescue the conversation, Sachin fumbles a disastrous answer regarding his startup finances.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The front door kicks wide open as Amal Davis bursts in singing a boisterous college anthem, holding a sack of raw fish.

season_arc.synopsis: Freezing upon seeing Reenu’s imposing parents, Amal immediately switches gears into an absurdly polished, deferential gentleman offering to brew authentic Pala-style Sulaimani tea. While Amal traps Father Roy in a hilarious discussion about rubber plantation economics, Sachin and Reenu share frantic whispered strategies in the kitchen corridor. Sachin tenderly wipes away a nervous smudge of tea dust from Reenu's cheek, reassuring her that he won't run away.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Mother Molly silently steps into the kitchen doorway, catching their intimate handhold in complete stillness.

season_arc.synopsis: To break the domestic tension, the family heads out for an evening walk along the breezy Marine Drive promenade where Father Roy deliberately pulls Sachin aside for a one-on-one audit. Father bluntly contrasts Sachin’s unpredictable freelance prospects against wealthy Gulf-settled engineering suitors who have sent marriage proposals for Reenu. Sachin swallows his pride and responds with sincere humility, affirming his relentless drive to build a real future.
season_arc.cliffhanger: A speeding street hawker's cart swerves uncontrollably toward Mother Molly in the bustling crowd.

season_arc.synopsis: Sachin lunges forward and shields Molly, bruising his own shoulder against the cart while gently steadying her onto a bench. At a nearby tea stall, while Father remains stoic, Molly tenderly inspects Sachin's scraped arm and observes how selflessly he prioritizes Reenu's comfort over his own pain. Back at the flat later that night, Reenu sits with her mother for a heart-to-heart, confessing how deeply Sachin stood by her when she was lost.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Father Roy enters the room and solemnly places a laminated matrimonial biodata of a German NRI doctor on the center table.

season_arc.synopsis: Determined to give Reenu's parents an unforgettable Kochi tour, Sachin borrows a classic Ambassador car to take them sightseeing across heritage Fort Kochi despite gathering monsoon clouds. Sachin navigates the narrow colonial streets like a seasoned guide, pointing out historic churches and antique cafes that genuinely delight Molly. However, as the skies burst into a violent monsoon deluge, the vintage car violently sputters and stalls right near the Chinese fishing nets.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Smoke billows from the car bonnet into the torrential rain, stranding the family in the middle of a flooded intersection.

season_arc.synopsis: Refusing to let the elders get drenched, Sachin gives his umbrella to Reenu and her parents while he wades knee-deep into the gushing rain to push the heavy car to safety. Through the rain-streaked window, Father Roy watches in total silence as a soaked Sachin tirelessly assists a roadside mechanic under the downpour without a single complaint. When the engine finally revives, Father asks Sachin point-blank under a café awning why Reenu should gamble her stable life on a dreamer.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Sachin looks straight into Father Roy's skeptical eyes, preparing to deliver the most defining speech of his life.

season_arc.synopsis: Standing drenched under the heritage café porch, Sachin delivers an earnest confession that he never had ambition until he fell in love with Reenu's brilliance and courage. He promises Father Roy that he will never cage Reenu's dreams or demand she change, but will walk beside her through every storm as an equal partner. Reenu's eyes brim with tears while Amal Davis gives a silent, emotionally choked thumbs-up from the corner.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Father Roy remains completely motionless for ten agonising seconds, then turns around and walks away into the café without saying a word.

season_arc.synopsis: The morning of the parents' departure arrives in somber quietness as bags are zipped up and Sachin waits outside the apartment to say a respectful goodbye. Assuming he has failed to win her father's approval, Sachin holds back his heartbreak while wishing them a safe journey back to Pala. As Father Roy steps into the elevator, Molly slips a quiet revelation to Reenu that Father stayed awake all night researching Sachin's business pitch on his tablet.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Father Roy abruptly blocks the closing elevator doors with his walking umbrella and gruffly barks at Sachin to get inside and carry the luggage.

season_arc.synopsis: At Ernakulam Junction railway platform amid whistling trains and bustling morning commuters, Father Roy halts before boarding the coach and hands Sachin a tin of homemade Pala banana chips along with his own vintage wrist watch. With a faint, affectionate smirk, Father Roy officially commands Sachin to accompany Reenu home to Pala for the upcoming Onam feast, giving his unconditional blessing. Reenu gasps in pure joy and leaps into Sachin's arms in an ecstatic embrace as Molly and Amal cheer.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Sachin spins Reenu around against the golden Kochi railway morning sunlight in a vibrant, romantic freeze-frame as the season credits roll.
